document.title: Partner's record of adjusted basis in the partnership interest (outside basis)
document.notes: No third party issues this. The Partner's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) supply a "Worksheet for Adjusting the Basis of a Partner's Interest in the Partnership" and state that item L of the K-1 "is based on the partnership's books and records and can't be used to figure the partner's adjusted basis." It is a required input to the first of the four loss limitations, and a K-1 loss cannot be routed until it is known. It carries no routable box.

boxes.label: Adjusted basis at the beginning of the partnership's tax year
Adjusted basis at the end of the partnership's tax year

extraction.note: A taxpayer's own record. No prescribed layout, so no structured model; read generically. Nothing routes out of it, so no figure depends on that read; W20 counts it as named-and-nothing-else.
